definitions.explanation: Raw materials used in cooking; food items before they are prepared into a dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{食材|しょくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食材|しょくざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.notes: 旬 refers to the peak season for food

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{食材|しょくざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{作|つく}ろう→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's make something with the ingredients in the fridge.

notes:
A general term for cooking ingredients. Related terms:
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧ - materials/ingredients (broader, also non-food)
- ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧/⟦{具材|ぐざい}→具材：06230_guzai⟧ - ingredients/toppings (in dishes like ramen, soup)
- ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧ - raw materials (on food labels)

Common collocations:
- {食材|しょくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (buy ingredients)
- {食材|しょくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (gather ingredients)
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食材|しょくざい} (local ingredients)
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{食材|しょくざい} (premium ingredients)
